scope: Emissor Fiscal and Monitor Fiscal only
purpose: Carry decisive failures found during independent installed-package reviews into every applicable language qualification. The generic fixture server does not implement this entire catalog automatically.
execution_rules: Use the exact installed package/archive and record its hash/runtime.
Exercise actual HTTP/TLS loopback and normal typed consumers; do not mock the SDK transport as positive proof.
Use only synthetic values here. Authorized live fiscal tests have a separate frozen procedure and cleanup ledger.
Keep negative cases and positive controls; report observed request counts and no-forward/no-replay evidence.
These cases do not prove full fiscal variants, platform readiness or safe-merge.

cases.title: Keep credential modes separate
cases.stimulus: Exercise company, reseller, issuer, Monitor, document token and public report capability modes; include public report download from a client that also holds company credentials.
cases.expected: Only the declared mode sends a request; a public report sends no company/Bearer headers, and no failure causes fallback.

cases.title: Complete close-delimited responses
cases.stimulus: Serve complete Content-Length with Connection:close, HTTP1.0, EOF-delimited and chunked variants; then call again. Also truncate each framed body.
cases.expected: Valid complete responses succeed; truncation fails; a subsequent call works without duplicating either request.

cases.title: Informational status and trailers
cases.stimulus: Serve 100/103 then200 and legal chunked trailers; add101, duplicated singleton and ambiguous CL+TE controls.
cases.expected: Bounded legal sequences succeed; protocol switch and ambiguous framing fail without another request.

cases.title: No implicit transport replay
cases.stimulus: Accept the whole request then close before response headers, on fresh and reused connections, for GET/POST/PUT/DELETE.
cases.expected: Exactly one application request per explicit SDK call; errors preserve applicable uncertainty and safe recovery reference.

cases.title: Error discriminators use property presence
cases.stimulus: Combine an otherwise valid success shape with error:false/null/zero/empty string/empty array/empty object.
cases.expected: Presence of the contract error property is failure; absence with a valid response remains success.

cases.title: Diagnostics collect the actual serialized snapshot
cases.stimulus: Put a synthetic private value in an extensible generic field, deeply nested up to the accepted request depth, and in an extensible key. Exercise a custom serializer if supported. Echo these in message/code/field/correlation. Include numeric JSON object property names, distinguish them from list indices, and preserve the actual wire object/list shape.
cases.expected: No accepted request value leaks in normal diagnostics. Snapshot serialization is stable; unsafe or excessive input is rejected before dispatch.

cases.title: UUID capabilities have contextual equivalence
cases.stimulus: Echo an observed report UUID in upper/lower/mixed hexadecimal case; contrast an ordinary password or document token that merely looks like a UUID.
cases.expected: Known UUID capabilities are protected across equivalent cases; opaque credentials retain literal case semantics.

cases.title: Recovery selectors remain usable
cases.stimulus: Return uncertain outcome after receiving a safe fiscal UUID/ID; explicitly use the protected retained selector in one consultation. Include credential/capability collision controls.
cases.expected: Ordinary diagnostics redact the selector; deliberate recovery uses the original serialized value. Credentials/capabilities are excluded, and no mutation is replayed.

cases.title: Effects are not inferred solely from HTTP verb
cases.stimulus: Exercise GET with declared possible effects, conditional Monitor refresh, and passive GET controls under timeout/5xx.
cases.expected: Uncertainty follows explicit effect policy and actual send state; passive reads do not inherit mutation claims.

cases.title: Documented file redirect remains usable metadata
cases.stimulus: Return the documented302 with absolute and relative Location; add missing/duplicate/malformed Location controls and a second destination observer.
cases.expected: Expose valid Location only through deliberate protected access. No implicit fetch, credential forwarding, origin trust or file-ready claim. Invalid or ambiguous metadata fails clearly.

cases.title: Unexpected redirect after a sent mutation
cases.stimulus: After receiving the complete mutation return302/303. Include a passive read control.
cases.expected: Keep mutation uncertainty and safe recovery reference; never follow or reissue. Passive reads remain nonmutating.

cases.title: Location capability redaction is contextual
cases.stimulus: Return a Location with a new UUID in its path and echo an equivalent case in correlation/errors. Contrast an opaque query token shaped like a UUID. Include UUIDs embedded in filenames with prefixes/suffixes, malformed authorities and invalid escapes adjacent to valid encoded UUIDs.
cases.expected: Path UUID capabilities do not leak; ordinary opaque query tokens are not silently treated as case-insensitive UUIDs. If header limits abort observation, do not retain a recovery selector that may collide with an unobserved capability; distinguish this from a body-size failure after complete headers.

cases.title: Offset pagination preserves page size
cases.stimulus: Serve a deterministic source of at least80 unique records, request page size50 and total item limit75.
cases.expected: Requests keep per_page50; collect exactly the first75 unique records and expose continuation page2/index25, with no redundant page3 request.

cases.title: Explicit page values are not replaced
cases.stimulus: Start above Int32 and test omitted page, explicit null, invalid per_page, nonadvancing metadata and page/item/deadline limits. Return per_page different from the explicit request or first observed page size; contrast a coherent empty final/out-of-range page.
cases.expected: Preserve a supported exact starting integer or reject a documented helper limit before I/O; never replace it with page1. Invalid input yields a structured validation error. Incompatible offset metadata must not yield a misleading complete collection.

cases.title: Report waits preserve capability context
cases.stimulus: First response is processing with UUID/URL/token; next error echoes the bare UUID in another case without the URL. Run independent workflows and an ordinary import control.
cases.expected: The same request payload is reused, waits are bounded with interval at least5s, report capabilities remain protected across calls, and context does not leak across workflows.

cases.title: Cancellation preserves sent-operation context
cases.stimulus: Interrupt/cancel after the server receives the whole mutation; contrast cancellation while queued before dispatch and a passive read.
cases.expected: Preserve applicable operation, uncertainty and safe reference; stop network work, retain runtime interruption semantics and never replay.

cases.title: Generated request wrappers do not collide with body components
cases.stimulus: Compile and run a normal typed consumer constructing body and path parameters through generated fields/setters; avoid a raw JSON constructor as the only proof.
cases.expected: Both operations expose correct wrapper fields and serialize the intended path/body. Audit other operation wrappers for the same naming collision.

cases.title: Object compositions retain common typed fields
cases.stimulus: Generate common properties/required together with anyOf/oneOf and check positive field access plus invalid typed assignments.
cases.expected: Alternatives preserve common typed fields and required constraints. Compilation of a raw JSON escape alone is insufficient.

cases.title: MIME does not establish file readiness
cases.stimulus: Return HTML/JSON masquerading as PDF/XML; include valid XML prolog/comments, valid PDF controls, protected variants, DTD and response-size bounds.
cases.expected: Reject incompatible bytes, preserve valid data and explicit nonfile/protection states, and perform no HTML execution, entity fetch or automatic decryption.

cases.title: Installed package supports an approved HTTPS environment
cases.stimulus: Configure an explicit HTTPS service origin/prefix, validate trust/hostname, and test userinfo/query/fragment/dot-segment rejection.
cases.expected: Use the configured service without recompiling SDK code; no response URL is automatically trusted and no credentials move to another origin.

cases.title: Observe sensitive Location across native header events
cases.stimulus: Information/upgrade callbacks or parser states carry a Location path UUID before a later error, an unsupported101, or an excessive1xx budget. Contrast final headers and literal opaque URI components.
cases.expected: Protect every accessible observed Location before continuing or rejecting; do not follow, authorize, or upgrade. Per-call context must not leak between clients/workflows.

cases.title: Case-distinct extension keys do not overwrite known fields
cases.stimulus: A schema-valid response contains known status/uuid plus distinct STATUS/UUID extension fields; vary property order and preserve the raw object.
cases.expected: Typed known properties bind exact JSON names only; extensions remain separate and usable, with no silent overwrite or drop.

cases.title: Response alternatives do not restrict another open branch
cases.stimulus: A valid success branch carries an unknown message object while an alternative error branch declares message as string.
cases.expected: Project the valid branch without applying unrelated branch-only field types. Preserve useful typed/common properties and extra data; do not replace the whole response model by an untyped escape.

cases.title: Semantic JSON integers remain exact through typed projection
cases.stimulus: Where the pinned response schema permits integer1, return JSON1.0 and equivalent exponent notation; contrast a nonintegral exact decimal and a value outside a documented native type bound.
cases.expected: Accept mathematical integers without rounding a fraction or silently replacing them; preserve raw numeric representation where promised and reject documented bounds clearly.

cases.title: File representation and success status both follow the contract
cases.stimulus: Exercise every declared report format including CSV/XLSX and positive ZIP/PDF controls. Send valid PDF bytes with undeclared201 where only200 is declared.
cases.expected: Declared formats work; binary paths validate the actual HTTP status and use2XX/default only when the contract declares them. Valid-looking bytes alone do not establish contractual success.
